name: akosua
description: Akosua — personal AI coding agent. Understand -> Research -> Plan -> Build -> Verify. Never guess.

akosua.plannerProvider.description: Model provider used for planning/review judgement.

akosua.editorProvider.description: Model provider used for code edits.

akosua.reviewerProvider.description: Model provider used to cross-review the other provider's work.

akosua.plannerModel.description: Planner model id (blank = provider default at integration time; set explicitly for reproducibility).

akosua.mcpServers.description: External MCP servers (stdio), e.g. [{"name":"github","command":"npx","args":["-y","@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"]}]. Tools appear as mcp_<name>_<tool>, read-only phases unless "allowBuild": true.

akosua.personalRules.description: Your standing instructions for the agent (all projects). Project-level AKOSUA_RULES.md adds on top. This is how Akosua never 'forgets' your rules between chats.

akosua.autocomplete.description: Ghost-text autocomplete (Cursor Tab analogue) using your Editor model route. Off by default: it spends API calls as you type.

akosua.applyProvider.description: Fast-apply provider for inline edits (blank = Editor route, then Planner). A small fast model is ideal here.

akosua.applyModel.description: Fast-apply model id for inline edits (blank = Editor model, then Planner model).

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Akosua
walkthroughs.description: Your AI pair-programmer that understands first, researches live docs, and never edits before your plan approval.

steps.title: Add your API keys
steps.description: Open the Akosua Settings tab and add a Claude and/or OpenAI key. Keys live in Windows Credential Manager — never in files.

media.markdown: Akosua uses YOUR keys. Open **[Akosua Settings](command:akosua.openSettings)**, paste a key, then use **Test**. Everything Akosua needs lives on that one page.

steps.title: Set your models
steps.description: On the same Akosua Settings tab: Planner (strongest), Editor (fast), Reviewer (cross-check). Akosua never guesses model names.

media.markdown: Set model IDs in **[Akosua Settings](command:akosua.openSettings)**. Use exact model IDs from your provider — Akosua never guesses them.

steps.title: Open a project & run the agent
steps.description: Open a folder, press Ctrl+L, describe the task. Watch: Understand → Research → Plan (your approval) → Build → Verify.

media.markdown: Press **Ctrl+L** and describe the task. The agent fingerprints your stack, reads the code, checks live docs, then stops for your **plan approval** before editing anything. Every run is checkpointed — Keep or Undo.

scripts.test: npm run compile && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test out/test/
